$comment: Channel profile and autonomous operator strategy for Form & Heritage, Boise, Idaho. Apply with: npm run channel:apply -- config/channel-profile.formandheritage.json

profile.goal: Earn custom furniture commissions from homeowners, interior designers and architects by showing how engineered furniture is designed, load-checked and built in a Boise studio.
profile.targetAudience: Homeowners furnishing a dining room, office or kitchen; interior designers and architects sourcing custom walnut tables, floating desks and hidden-mount shelving; woodworkers and engineers curious how CAD and load analysis apply to furniture.
profile.brandVoice: Calm, precise and plain-spoken. An engineer explaining decisions, not a salesman. Show the reasoning: loads, spans, joinery, why a cable or a steel rod is there. No hype, no jargon without a one-line explanation.
profile.callToAction: Subscribe to @FormHeritage for the next build. Have a space in mind? Start a project at formandheritage.com and we reply within one business day with questions, ideas and a rough range.
profile.visualStyle: warm walnut and black steel, natural workshop light, clean CAD and simulation views, minimal text overlays
bannedTopics: client names or addresses without consent

strategy.objective: Build a steady flow of qualified custom furniture inquiries from the Boise area and from designers nationwide by publishing one engineering-led furniture video per week that shows the design, analysis and build of real pieces.
strategy.audience: Homeowners, interior designers and architects who want custom walnut tables, floating desks or hidden-mount shelving built to last; secondary audience of makers and engineers interested in CAD, load checks and topology optimization applied to furniture.
strategy.valueProposition: The only furniture studio in Boise where a mechanical engineer models and load-checks every piece before it is cut. Viewers see exactly why a table, desk or shelf will hold what they put on it, for generations.
contentPillars: Build stories: one commissioned piece from room model to install
Engineering explained: cantilevers, cables, hidden rods, topology-optimized brackets
Shop techniques: slab matching, butterfly keys, CNC and lathe work
Buyer's guides: choosing a dining table, floating desk or wall shelf that lasts
Workshop notes: prototypes, 3D prints, carved topographic maps
strategy.successMetric: Project inquiries that mention YouTube, tracked through the contact form, plus average view duration above 50 percent
strategy.constraints: Every video must be approved before publishing. Only show pieces Form & Heritage actually built or designed; label renders as renders. Never state a load rating that has not been checked. Keep each video under 10 minutes. Use the free local slideshow unless a video provider is explicitly enabled. Mention Boise, Idaho naturally for local discovery. Refer to the channel as Form & Heritage and the handle as @FormHeritage; the website is formandheritage.com and Instagram is @FormandHeritage.
